analyses.name: same_sign erratum recompute
analyses.criterion: protocol-definition same-sign >= 10/15 -> partial transfer of path-combination layer holds; never revise the 15-path list

analyses.name: APACHE IV benchmark
analyses.criterion: descriptive only, no pass gate; missingness reported as-is

analyses.name: measurement-density strata attribution
analyses.criterion: pre-specified hypothesis (attenuation of lost paths & +87lab anti-transfer in well-measured strata S1/S3); report as-is whether confirmed or refuted

analyses.name: XGBoost zero-shot
analyses.criterion: descriptive; report AUPRC difference vs linear numeric arm

analyses.name: eICU native path mining
analyses.criterion: H1 full-overlap >= 5 / H2 unordered-overlap >= 8 (and full < 5) / H3 otherwise; never a basis for rewriting MIMIC list

analyses.name: concept budget curve
analyses.criterion: descriptive; ranking by MIMIC train |logit| only; retention table, bootstrap CI on eICU side (B=1000, seed=42)

analyses.name: SAPS II rebuild feasibility
analyses.criterion: feasibility memo only; not implemented this round
